items.title: Wall Street May Be Sleeping on This AI Growth Story, The Stock Has 97% Upside
items.summary: ServiceNow just delivered one of enterprise software's strongest quarters on record, yet the stock sits 25% below its 52-week high. Something in that disconnect is driving a bold call from our analysts, and the reasoning behind it challenges the market's entire read on AI monetization.

items.title: Palantir and Microsoft Drop. Why the AI Revival Is Hitting Software Stocks.
items.summary: Palantir slid 1.2% and Microsoft dipped 1.1%.  Salesforce ServiceNow  and  Workday  were among the other software stocks trading in the red.  The moves came as shares of chip and optical networking companies rallied, following a strong batch of earnings reports that signaled to the market that demand for AI remains robust.
